prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='DWT_rf', seasonality_champion='ONLY_FT_rf', recommended_method='stl_hierarchical_stacking'. Narrative: DWT_rf achieves perfect trend correlation (1.0) while ONLY_FT_rf leads seasonality (0.278), creating a natural split for STL-hierarchical stacking. ETS wins overall RMSE (21.99) but rankings are unstable (Kendall τ=-0.30) with high model redundancy (0.91 correlation), favoring decomposition-aware combination over simple averaging. Concept drift and autocorrelated residuals in top models further support robust hierarchical stacking.
